sections.title: Holdings and funding
sections.instruction: For every asset, quantity, value, weightPercent; BNB potential funding separately. Cite frozen portfolio evidence.

sections.title: Cost and performance
sections.instruction: Known cost, unrealized/realized PnL and unknown history. Deposits are not gains.

sections.title: Cross-round changes
sections.instruction: Quantity versus market-price changes; prior proposals are not fills. If no comparable previous snapshot exists, state NOT_COMPARABLE; never substitute the current market-window return.

sections.title: Position recommendation
sections.instruction: Concentration issues from facts, hold/reduce/add eligibility; uncertainty and missing accounting.

sections.title: Hourly trends
sections.instruction: For EACH BTCUSDT/ETHUSDT/BNBUSDT: tool source, first/last times, firstOpenToLastCloseBps and lastCloseVsSma from computed metrics.

sections.title: Short-term comparison
sections.instruction: Frozen one-minute metrics, their actual window and evidence. Explain differences with hourly observations without conflating windows.

sections.title: Conditional scenarios
sections.instruction: Evidence-grounded entry/reduction scenarios and invalidation. No invented RSI or price thresholds.

sections.title: Limitations
sections.instruction: Missing data, CEX versus DEX limitations, timestamp mismatch and uncertainty.

sections.title: Per-asset news
sections.instruction: For BTCB, ETH and WBNB separately: headline, publication time, URL, relevance; or no relevant item found after search. Label HEADLINE_ONLY or FULL_TEXT.

sections.title: Verification
sections.instruction: Which important source bodies were actually fetched; what facts those bodies support. Failed retrievals and forecasts must be explicit.

sections.title: Potential impact
sections.instruction: Separate observed event from inferred asset impact and horizon. Do not claim price impact is proven.

sections.title: Limitations
sections.instruction: Unverified/old/irrelevant items, gaps and conflicting accounts.

sections.title: Verified macro facts
sections.instruction: Official source URL/publication date and actual policy facts visible in fetched text; unknown CPI/rates remain unknown. Distinguish historical pre-meeting expectations in minutes from the actual past decision and current future scenarios.

sections.title: Asset impact channels
sections.instruction: Explain potential BTC/ETH/BNB channels as interpretation, not direct proof.

sections.title: Scenarios
sections.instruction: Conditional implications and horizon without inventing numeric releases.

sections.title: Limitations
sections.instruction: Unobserved time series, old releases, unavailable documents and uncertainty.

sections.title: Per-asset pool observations
sections.instruction: For every asset give pool identity, observed liquidity, DEX, timestamp and evidence; avoid overlapping sums.

sections.title: Asset and protocol risks
sections.instruction: Distinguish known issuer/bridge mechanisms from verified incidents; cite actual evidence for incident claims.

sections.title: Trading constraints
sections.instruction: Observed liquidity threshold versus executable quote limitations; zero holdings do not prohibit BUY with BNB funding.

sections.title: Limitations
sections.instruction: Missing flows, holders, depth, bridge reserves or source checks. No invented whale activity.

sections.title: Deterministic limits
sections.instruction: Copy per-asset weightPercent/limitPercent/overLimit and totalTokens equivalents from facts. State exactly which limits are breached.

sections.title: Funding and exposure
sections.instruction: BNB potential funding and price risk separately; known/unknown capital, Gas and executable quote limits.

sections.title: Hard constraints
sections.instruction: Permissible target bounds and unresolved violations; hard rules cannot be cancelled by market conditions.

sections.title: Risk gaps
sections.instruction: Evidence freshness, liquidity limitations, missing data and residual risk.

sections.title: Authoritative state
sections.instruction: Portfolio/funding and actual breached limits from facts; do not repeat role arithmetic errors.

sections.title: Role evidence review
sections.instruction: Describe accepted/rejected/qualified conclusions, principal evidence and retained disagreements.

sections.title: Proposed strategy
sections.instruction: Explain structured signals or reason for no signals, allocation basis and hard-rule priority. Proposals are unexecuted.

sections.title: Residual limitations
sections.instruction: Missing/weak/contradictory evidence, unresolved current violations and non-execution boundary.
